description: Score a .glb or .gltf without Godot: flipped faces, open edges, missing normals, UVs or tangents, textures, node names, budgets. Pass `archetype` (a name such as 'car' or 'helikopter', or an id) to also check it is what it should be: required parts, pivots, wheel axes, size (unit mistakes), direction. Pass `contract` to hold it to a model.contract.json, and `max_triangles` to flag a heavy model. Returns an overall score, a score per category (geometry, materials, performance, rig, and archetype when given) and the findings: `detail` brief shows up to 25 errors and warnings, full shows every finding with its fix. An error result when there are errors. Read-only. godot_model_build already lints what it builds; to see the shape use godot_model_view, for the raw contents godot_model_inspect.

archetype.description: what the model should be, e.g. car, helikopter, vehicle.wheeled.car

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

file.description: Path to a .glb or .gltf file, inside the project.

max_triangles.description: flag a model with more triangles than this

name: godot_model_lint
title: Review a 3D model
